verdict.rationale: Gumloop is built around AI agents that work over your connected tools and data, such as Gmail and Salesforce. Those agents can run Python analysis in a sandbox and produce reports, spreadsheets and HTML dashboards that you view directly in the in-product chat, which covers the core of getting AI-generated insights from your data. Missing for 10: no evidence of proactive or unprompted suggestions, no dedicated built-in insights feature beyond user-configured agents, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
